name: Saionji Youko
source: A beautiful girl with a personality Smart, refined, mature and mischievous. Her Hobbies In the evening she likes to drink tea while enjoying the scenery around her house. love self-reliance without the help of her maid and loved by the people around her. She likes food cooked by Rei and Rei respect her as a older sister. she came from a very wealthy family.
